meta_description:
482 likes, 22 comments - siddharthajoshi on October 7, 2026: "5 days behind the wheel of an iconic UAZ (Ulyanovsky Avtomobilny Zavod), white-knuckling through remote mountain passes! 

Born in Soviet times, the UAZ is a legendary off-road icon engineered purely for survival in extreme terrain. With no power steering, no modern electronic safety nets, and heavy manual gear shifts, driving it requires raw physical focus and mechanical intuition. Mastering this Soviet workhorse over steep mountain passes was the ultimate thrill.

Every night brought a fresh view as I slept on a new mountain top or parked just outside an ancient stone village, cooking simple meals and watching movies in the back of the truck. But the highlight of it all was my final night along Sulak Canyon - sleeping right under the open sky and waking up with the rising sun, no plans or agenda, just total freedom.

Beyond the raw driving, what made every single day special was meeting complete strangers along the way - from stopping in remote villages for hot tea to making lifelong friends on the road.

Stepping completely out of my comfort zone behind the wheel turned out to be the adventure of a lifetime.

#dagestan #uaz".
